title: UneceLocationParty
description: An individual, a group, or a body having a role related to a location.

countryId.description: A unique country identifier for this location party.

definedContact.description: A trade contact defined for this location party.

description.description: A textual description of this location party.

faxCommunication.description: Fax communication information for this location party.

identifier.description: A unique identifier of this location party.

locationPartyRoleCode.description: A code specifying a role of this location party.

name.description: A name, expressed as text, for this location party.

postalAddress.description: A postal address for this location party.

providedService.description: A transport service provided by this location party.

specifiedLogisticsLocation.description: A logistics location or place specified for this party.

specifiedTransportPerson.description: A transport related person specified for this location party.

telephoneCommunication.description: Telephone communication information for this location party.

typeCode.description: A code specifying the type of location party that is independent of its role.

uRICommunication.description: Uniform Resource Identifier (URI) communication information for this location party, such as a web or email address.
